plan.purpose: Public development qualification of bounded reference search and recovery controls, not model difficulty calibration
plan.stopping_rule: Complete the fixed matrix. Retain search exhaustion and controls whose initial-reference prerequisite is unavailable. No seed filtering or replacement.
plan.interpretation: Existing experimental initial catalogues are reused. Recovery is newly checked; these are public development cases, not held-out structures or independent model evidence.
plan.promotion_rule: A scale needs complete reference success, failing greedy/rarest/no-recovery controls, and successful budget/recovery rescue controls on every sampled seed to pass this offline gate. Passing does not establish model discrimination.

interpretation: Offline controls only. Non-revising ablations reuse the plan obtained from the same public initial catalogue; they measure recovery necessity, not independent solver speed. Missing prerequisites remain unexecuted, not invented failures. No scored scales are added.
